answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments ensure that a hollow identity lacking historical state cannot satisfy the sequential proof of work required by a VDF-based zephyr of randomized sortition. By mandating staking collateral via hardware roots cast in copper, the protocol enforces slashing penalties that render the expected utility of identity cloning strictly negative. This architecture achieves BFT finality through a Nash equilibrium where the cost of generating zero-knowledge verifiable delays exceeds the marginal revenue of a Sybil attack.
